info.name: JAGGAER ASO Customer Host Entity Service Async Attributes API

description.content:
The Customer Host Entity Service (CHES) API provides system-to-system REST endpoints for managing customer hosts, users, events, and templates within the JAGGAER Advanced Sourcing Optimizer (ASO) platform. It enables creation and retrieval of sourcing events, template management, user administration, and location-based rate structure queries using OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens combined with API key authentication.
